info.title: QR Encoder
info.summary: Generate a QR code as PNG, JPG, SVG or text.
info.description: Generates a QR code from any text or URL and returns a hosted image, inline SVG markup, or the raw matrix as text. Images are kept at the returned URL, so you can hot-link them directly.

get.summary: Encode text or a URL as a QR code
get.description: The endpoint sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`. Call it from your backend all the same, so your API key never reaches the browser. With `format=svg` or `format=text` the markup is returned inline in `data.text` instead of a hosted file. With `resp=image` the image bytes are streamed directly, which makes the URL usable as an ``.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The text or URL to encode. URL-encode it when it contains `&` or `#`. Up to 4000 characters.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `png` (default), `jpg`, `svg`, or `text` for a 0/1 matrix in JSON.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Pixels per QR module, from `1` to `20`.

parameters.name: accuracy
parameters.description: Error-correction level. Higher levels survive more damage but produce denser codes.

parameters.name: padding
parameters.description: Quiet zone around the code in modules, 0 to 20. Default 2.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Foreground colour as six hex digits, for example `ff6700`, or a decimal RGB integer. Default black.

parameters.name: bgcolor
parameters.description: Background colour as six hex digits, for example `ff6700`, or a decimal RGB integer. Default white.

parameters.name: resp
parameters.description: `json` returns metadata and the image URL. `image` streams the image bytes directly with the right `Content-Type`.

200.description: A successful reply wraps the result in `data`.

status.description: `200` on success. See status codes below.

qr.description: Absolute URL of the generated image (`png` and `jpg` formats).

text.description: Inline SVG markup or the text matrix (`svg` and `text` formats only).

accuracy.description: Error-correction level as a single letter: `L`, `M`, `Q` or `H`.

x-status-codes.title: Missing content
x-status-codes.description: `content` was empty or absent. `data` carries the message.

x-status-codes.title: Encoding failed
x-status-codes.description: The encoder could not build the matrix. Shorten the content or lower `accuracy`.
